tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
XikeStor 12-Port 10G SFP+ L3 Managed Network Switch – High-Performance, Scalable, and Secure


Upgrade your network with the XikeStor 12-Port 10G SFP+ L3 Web Managed Ethernet Switch, designed for businesses, data centers, and high-speed networking environments. This Layer 3 managed switch delivers ultra-fast 10 Gbps connectivity, intelligent traffic management, and advanced security features, making it ideal for enterprises, ISPs, and cloud computing.

Key Features:

  • 12x 10G SFP+ Ports – Lightning-fast, high-bandwidth connections for seamless data transmission.
  • L3 Routing & VLAN Support – Advanced Layer 3 networking, including static & dynamic routing, VLAN segmentation, and QoS for optimal traffic flow.
  • Web-Based Management & SNMP – Intuitive GUI with remote monitoring and SNMP support for easy network control.
  • Enterprise-Grade Security – ACL, IGMP Snooping, STP, RSTP, and LACP ensure a secure and stable network environment.
  • High-Speed Backbone & Aggregation – Perfect for data centers, high-performance computing (HPC), and video streaming applications.
  • Rack-Mount & Silent Operation – Compact, durable design with efficient cooling for 24/7 reliable performance.


Why Choose XikeStor?

  • Built for high-speed, low-latency networking, the XikeStor 12-Port 10G SFP+ switch is an ideal solution for enterprises looking for scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency. Whether you're managing cloud services, large-scale networking, or a high-bandwidth office, this 10G SFP+ Ethernet switch ensures seamless and efficient data transmission.
  • Boost your network’s performance today! Get the XikeStor 12-Port 10G SFP+ L3 Managed Ethernet Switch for high-speed, enterprise-grade connectivity.
